name: Larion and Muigin

narrative.details:
See Muigin over there? It's HIS fault we're lost!

I'm the one that knew the way, but he insisted he knew a shortcut, and we ended up here!

To make matters worse, now he keeps sending his crazy plant pests to annoy me. I'm so angry that I'm not planning on talking to him any time soon, but these pests are too much to handle.

Why don't we try to limit his supply, first thing. Go out and hunt some Bloodpetals, then return to me.
narrative.objectives: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks for your help, adventurer, but I'm afraid I have some bad news...
narrative.requestItemsText: Muigin needs to apologize first before I'll talk to him again!
